top_signals.title: French Trader Sucden Warns of Sugar Oversupply as Futures Rally
top_signals.summary: The global sugar market is oversupplied, and the outlook for investors is being blurred by a lack of data, according to French trader Sucres et Denrees SA.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Berkshire CEO Abel Puts Cash to Work
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Amanda Cantrell discusses Berkshire Hathaway's recent financial moves, highlighting a significant increase in share buybacks to $4.5 billion in the second quarter, a notable step up from earlier activity. She speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Metabase SQLi zero-day exploited in customer data-theft attacks
top_signals.summary: A critical Metabase SQL injection vulnerability was exploited in zero-day attacks to breach customer instances in data theft attacks, known to impact Framework and Tally. [...]
